rationale: Both Sylvester and Riya work at the intersection of security and systems-level computing. Sylvester's focus on cybersecurity and digital privacy complements Riya's deep expertise in low-level systems, FPGA acceleration, and hardware-software co-design—areas where security considerations are increasingly critical for edge devices and neuromorphic systems. Their combined interest in secure, efficient computing could spark useful conversation around threat models in emerging hardware architectures.
intro_message: Sylvester Reagan, meet Riya — you both care about security in cutting-edge computing systems, and her work on FPGA-accelerated neuromorphic computing could benefit from your cybersecurity perspective.
